sentences.en: Shortly after the 9-11 attacks, a photo made its way around the Internet.
sentences.zh: 9·11袭击发生后不久，一张照片在互联网上流传开来。

sentences.en: It showed a man standing on the observation deck at the World Trade Center in New York City.
sentences.zh: 照片显示一名男子站在纽约世界贸易中心的观景台上。

sentences.en: He's wearing a knitted black cap, sunglasses, and an unzipped parka.
sentences.zh: 他戴着一顶针织黑帽、太阳镜，穿着一件没拉拉链的派克大衣。

sentences.en: Behind him, a deep blue sky, views of Manhattan and the Hudson River.
sentences.zh: 在他身后，是深蓝色的天空，以及曼哈顿和哈德逊河的景色。

sentences.en: But there's something else behind him, too.
sentences.zh: 但他的身后还有别的东西。

sentences.en: It's headed straight toward the tower.
Rumor had it, the man died that day, and his camera was later pulled from the rubble.
sentences.zh: 有传言说，那名男子当天就遇难了，他的相机后来是从废墟中找出来的。

sentences.en: It's an amazing shot, and an amazing story, and it's totally false.
sentences.zh: 这是一张令人惊叹的照片，也是一个惊人的故事，但它完全是假的。

sentences.en: The man is Peter Guzli, and he's Hungarian.
sentences.zh: 这名男子叫彼得·古兹利，是匈牙利人。

sentences.en: The picture was snapped several years before the terrorist attacks.
sentences.zh: 这张照片是在恐怖袭击发生前几年拍摄的。

sentences.en: After 9-11, Peter Guzli photoshopped in the plane and emailed the image to a few friends as a joke.
sentences.zh: 9·11之后，彼得·古兹利把飞机P进了照片，并作为玩笑发邮件给了几个朋友。

sentences.en: Those friends shared the image with their friends, and their friends shared it with more friends,
sentences.zh: 那些朋友把照片分享给了他们的朋友，他们的朋友又分享给了更多人，

sentences.en: and soon, the photo was everywhere.
sentences.zh: 很快，这张照片就传遍了各地。

sentences.en: Ten years after the attacks, Peter Guzli publicly apologized.
sentences.zh: 袭击发生十年后，彼得·古兹利公开道歉。

sentences.en: He said he was ashamed and sorry, and hadn't considered the consequences.
sentences.zh: 他说他感到羞愧和抱歉，当时没有考虑到后果。

sentences.en: I never thought it would go out of my tight circle of friends.
sentences.zh: 我从没想过它会传出我那个小小的朋友圈。

sentences.en: That should have been the end of it, but it wasn't.
sentences.zh: 本该到此为止，但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: The image turned Peter Guzli into a meme star.
sentences.zh: 这张照片让彼得·古兹利成了网红表情包主角。

sentences.en: On social media today, he's known as the tourist guy, or sometimes, as the tourist of death.
sentences.zh: 如今在社交媒体上，他被称为“游客哥”，有时也被称为“死亡游客”。

sentences.en: Strangers online have photoshopped the same image of an expressionless Peter Guzli,
sentences.zh: 网上的陌生人把这张面无表情的彼得·古兹利的照片，

sentences.en: with his parka, knit cap, and sunglasses,
sentences.zh: 连同他的派克大衣、针织帽和太阳镜一起，

sentences.en: into all kinds of famous scenes where something terrible has just happened, or is about to happen.
sentences.zh: P进了各种发生了或即将发生可怕事件的著名场景中。

sentences.en: He's in the motorcade with John F.
Kennedy, moments before the president gets shot,
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪的车队里，就在总统遇刺前的那一刻，

sentences.en: in a cave next to Osama bin Laden,
sentences.zh: 出现在奥萨马·本·拉登旁边的洞穴里，

sentences.en: in the foreground, as the Hindenburg explodes.
sentences.zh: 出现在兴登堡号飞艇爆炸时的前景中。

sentences.en: Whether he wants this role today is not up to Peter Guzli anymore.
sentences.zh: 今天他是否还想要这个角色，已经由不得彼得·古兹利了。

sentences.en: The tourist of death now belongs to the Internet.
It does what it wants with the image.
sentences.zh: 它想怎么处理这张照片就怎么处理。

sentences.en: Coming up, we have the story of a young man who made a terrible mistake on social media.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我们将讲述一个年轻人在社交媒体上犯下严重错误的故事。

sentences.en: A mistake that destroyed the future he had imagined for himself.
sentences.zh: 一个摧毁了他为自己构想的未来的错误。

sentences.en: This story is about a fault line that runs through our lives.
sentences.zh: 这个故事关乎我们生活中存在的一条断层线。

sentences.en: On social media, we're encouraged to be quick, clever, edgy.
sentences.zh: 在社交媒体上，我们被鼓励要反应迅速、聪明、前卫。

sentences.en: The funny videos and amusing banter we engage in seem low stakes.
sentences.zh: 我们参与的那些搞笑视频和逗趣调侃看起来无伤大雅。
一个更大的世界正在注视着。

sentences.en: It's usually silent, but every now and then,
sentences.zh: 它通常是沉默的，但偶尔，

sentences.en: something we say or do can ignite a firestorm.
sentences.zh: 我们所说或所做的事情可能会引发一场风暴。

sentences.en: And then, nothing you say can undo the damage.
sentences.zh: 到那时，你说什么都无法挽回损失。

sentences.en: Beauty sometimes appears in unexpected places.
sentences.zh: 美有时会出现在意想不到的地方。

sentences.en: I'm sitting in a low chair woven from bungee cord,
sentences.zh: 我坐在一张用蹦极绳编织的矮椅子上，

sentences.en: staring at the crumpled sheets of an unmade bed.
sentences.zh: 盯着一张未整理的床上皱巴巴的床单。

sentences.en: To my right is a desk cluttered with textbooks,
sentences.zh: 我的右边是一张堆满教科书的桌子，

sentences.en: a stick of deodorant, and a half-eaten jar of Nutella.
sentences.zh: 上面有除臭剂和一罐吃了一半的能多益巧克力酱。

sentences.en: The room has the slight tangy smell of a gym locker.
sentences.zh: 房间里有一股淡淡的健身房储物柜的酸味。

sentences.en: It belongs to a 20-year-old named William.
sentences.zh: 这是属于一个叫威廉的20岁年轻人的。

sentences.en: We're not using his last name for reasons that will become clear shortly.
sentences.zh: 出于稍后会明了的原因，我们不使用他的姓氏。

sentences.en: After chatting for a few minutes, he pulls a worn case from under his bed.
sentences.zh: 聊了几分钟后，他从床底下拿出一个磨损的琴盒。

sentences.en: So, this is actually a 1910 violin by a guy named Heberlein.
sentences.zh: 所以，这其实是一把1910年的小提琴，出自一个叫赫伯莱因的人之手。
对，海因里希·西奥多·赫伯莱因。
琥珀色的木头闪闪发光。

sentences.en: William got this violin when he was just a sophomore in high school.
sentences.zh: 威廉在高二时得到了这把小提琴。

sentences.en: I emptied my bank account for it.
sentences.zh: 我掏空了我的银行账户才买下它。

sentences.en: My parents emptied their bank accounts for it.
sentences.zh: 我父母也掏空了他们的银行账户。

sentences.en: And my grandparents helped me out, too.
sentences.zh: 我祖父母也帮了我一把。

sentences.en: They did it because William is good.
sentences.zh: 他们这样做是因为威廉很有天赋。

sentences.en: By ninth grade, William's violin instructor was letting him choose what he wanted to play.
sentences.zh: 到九年级时，威廉的小提琴老师已经让他自己选择想演奏的曲目了。

sentences.en: The first piece I picked to play was Viotti's 22nd Violin Concerto.
sentences.zh: 我选的第一首曲子是维奥蒂的第22号小提琴协奏曲。
我只是听到了这段旋律。

sentences.en: It felt strange to hear such elegant music in this messy room.
sentences.zh: 在这个凌乱的房间里听到如此优雅的音乐，感觉很奇妙。

sentences.en: He goes from a boyish 20-year-old to someone mature and intense.
sentences.zh: 他从一个孩子气的20岁年轻人变成了一个成熟而专注的人。

sentences.en: His body sways back and forth as it follows the bow.
sentences.zh: 他的身体随着琴弓的拉动来回摇摆。

sentences.en: It's like he's become a part of his instrument.
sentences.zh: 就像他已经成为了乐器的一部分。

sentences.en: So, like, that's the opening section to that concerto.
sentences.zh: 所以，大概就是那部协奏曲的开头部分。

sentences.en: And that would just get stuck in my head so easily that I just, I so wanted to play it.
sentences.zh: 那段旋律很容易就钻进我的脑子里，所以我太想演奏它了。

sentences.en: And you don't need music to play it?
sentences.zh: 你演奏它不需要乐谱吗？

sentences.en: For the next half hour, he treats me to a mini concert, one that includes the middle
sentences.zh: 接下来的半小时里，他为我献上了一场迷你音乐会，包括欧内斯特·布洛赫组曲的中间

sentences.en: movement of a suite by Ernest Bloch and compositions by Paganini, Vuitton, and Sibelius.
sentences.zh: 乐章，以及帕格尼尼、维厄当和西贝柳斯的作曲。

sentences.en: After he stashes his violin, the conversation turns to other topics, winding its way eventually
sentences.zh: 在他收好小提琴后，谈话转向了其他话题，最终绕到了

sentences.en: Just mentioning the word trips something in William's brain.
sentences.zh: 仅仅提到这个词就触动了威廉大脑里的某个开关。

sentences.en: Wait, let's see how many digits of pi I remember.
sentences.zh: 等等，看看我还能记住多少位圆周率。

sentences.en: I, like, learned them in, like, sixth grade.
sentences.zh: 我大概是在六年级学的。

sentences.en: That's as much as I know.
Given that it goes on infinitely long, that's not very much.
sentences.zh: 考虑到它无限不循环，这其实没多少。

sentences.en: The moment reveals something about William.
sentences.zh: 这一刻揭示了威廉的一些特质。

sentences.en: He likes to see how far he can push himself.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢看自己能走多远。

sentences.en: It's reflected in everything he does.
sentences.zh: 这反映在他所做的一切事情中。

sentences.en: He plays with a professional symphony orchestra.
sentences.zh: 他与专业交响乐团一起演奏。

sentences.en: He's won awards for economics and physics.
sentences.zh: 他赢过经济学和物理学奖项。
他参加竞技高尔夫比赛。

sentences.en: His list of achievements is long.
But that list got tossed out when the mistake he made undid everything.
sentences.zh: 但当他犯下的那个错误毁掉一切时，那份清单就被抛弃了。

sentences.en: We're going to tell you about that mistake.
sentences.zh: 我们将告诉你关于那个错误的事情。

sentences.en: But first, it's important to understand something about William's upbringing.
sentences.zh: 但首先，了解威廉的成长背景很重要。

sentences.en: He grew up in a small city in Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 他在宾夕法尼亚州的一个小城市长大。

sentences.en: And it's kind of in the middle of nowhere.
He was, as his father Jeffrey tells me, an exceptionally kind and gentle child.
sentences.zh: 正如他父亲杰弗里告诉我的，他是一个极其善良和温柔的孩子。

sentences.en: My wife, when he was born, and for the first years of his life, always referred to him as
sentences.zh: 我妻子在他出生时，以及他生命的最初几年里，总是称他为

sentences.en: sweet William because his disposition was so incredibly sweet.
sentences.zh: “甜心威廉”，因为他的性格实在是太甜美了。

sentences.en: William's family isn't wealthy, but he had plenty of advantages.
sentences.zh: 威廉的家庭并不富裕，但他拥有很多优势。

sentences.en: Old home videos show what seems like a pretty idyllic childhood.
sentences.zh: 旧的家庭录像展示了他看似相当田园诗般的童年。

sentences.en: There's one of William running to home base in Littlery.
sentences.zh: 其中一段是威廉在利特里跑向本垒。

sentences.en: Another of him when he's just eight, sitting in the cockpit of a small plane.
sentences.zh: 另一段是他八岁时，坐在小型飞机的驾驶舱里。
嘿，威廉，你刚才做了什么？

sentences.en: We flew around out there a bit, and then we came in.
sentences.zh: 我们在外面飞了一圈，然后就回来了。

sentences.en: And there's one when he's 11, recounting for his dad every shot he made on an 18-hole golf course.
sentences.zh: 还有一段是他11岁时，向父亲讲述他在18洞高尔夫球场上的每一杆。

sentences.en: The first hole, I had a little birdie putt.
sentences.zh: 第一洞，我有一个小鸟球推杆。

sentences.en: Second hole, I hit a sand wedge in and do a couple feet in the safe part.
sentences.zh: 第二洞，我用沙坑杆打进去，离洞口几英尺，很稳。

sentences.en: And then three, I failed to get up and down.
sentences.zh: 然后第三洞，我没能一切一推。

sentences.en: By high school, he was playing with a local symphony orchestra.
sentences.zh: 到了高中，他已经开始和当地的交响乐团一起演奏了。

sentences.en: Without further ado, I would like to announce that William is the 2017 Forming Artist of the Year.
sentences.zh: 废话少说，我要宣布威廉是2017年度表演艺术家。

sentences.en: William put the same energy into his studies.
sentences.zh: 威廉把同样的精力投入到了学习中。

sentences.en: He had an epiphany one day in his sophomore year of high school during AP Physics.
sentences.zh: 高二那年，他在AP物理课上突然顿悟了。

sentences.en: The class was studying momentum, or the work energy theorem, he can't quite remember.
sentences.zh: 当时班上正在学习动量，或者是功与能定理，他记不太清了。

sentences.en: And he began to see connections he hadn't seen before.
sentences.zh: 他开始看到以前从未发现的联系。

sentences.en: You know, these are ideas that if you first look at them, they're kind of crazy.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些想法如果你第一次看，会觉得有点疯狂。

sentences.en: But you do the math, and you convince yourself of it, and you think about it.
sentences.zh: 但你做一下数学计算，说服自己，然后深入思考它。

sentences.en: You think about it hard, and you realize that they make total sense, and they're second nature.
sentences.zh: 你认真思考，就会意识到它们完全讲得通，而且成了第二天性。

sentences.en: And when you arrive at that point, that's just so satisfying to me.
sentences.zh: 当你达到那个点时，对我来说真是太满足了。

sentences.en: More than anything, William says he loves moments of epiphany, when everything becomes clear.
sentences.zh: 威廉说，他最喜欢的就是这种顿悟的时刻，一切都变得清晰明了。

sentences.en: If you haven't picked up on this already, I like William.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没发现，我挺喜欢威廉的。

sentences.en: I like him not because of his math skills or his violin playing,
sentences.zh: 我喜欢他不是因为他的数学能力或小提琴演奏，

sentences.en: but because of a single quality that cuts across different domains in his life.
sentences.zh: 而是因为他身上有一种贯穿不同领域的特质。

sentences.en: William takes genuine pleasure in ideas and learning.
sentences.zh: 威廉从思想和学习中获得了真正的快乐。

sentences.en: When you combine that with drive and determination, it's a pretty special combination.
sentences.zh: 当你把这种特质与动力和决心结合起来时，这是一种非常特别的组合。

sentences.en: I tag along as he goes to practice at a nearby golf course.
sentences.zh: 我跟着他去附近的高尔夫球场练习。
我们站在一个小山坡上。

sentences.en: William pulls out a club and takes a few practice swings.
sentences.zh: 威廉拿出一根球杆，做了几次练习挥杆。

sentences.en: This is actually my coach's three-wood.
sentences.zh: 这其实是我教练的三号木。

sentences.en: He studies the club and concentrates on a ball in front of him.
sentences.zh: 他研究着球杆，专注于面前的球。

sentences.en: If I hit this well, it should get to the green.
sentences.zh: 如果我打得好，它应该能上果岭。

sentences.en: The green he's aiming for is a tiny speck across a road on top of another far-off hill.
sentences.zh: 他瞄准的果岭是远方另一座山顶上路对面的一小点。

sentences.en: After he hits the ball, I lose sight of it.
sentences.zh: 在他击球后，我的视线跟丢了球。

sentences.en: But William seems to know where it's gone.
sentences.zh: 但威廉似乎知道它飞到哪里去了。

sentences.en: So I have a general idea that this hole is about, give or take, 270 yards long.
sentences.zh: 所以我大概知道这个洞长约270码左右。

sentences.en: So I should be, you know, not that far from the green.
sentences.zh: 所以我应该，你知道，离果岭不远了。

sentences.en: Three more strokes, and the ball is in the hole for par.
sentences.zh: 再挥三杆，球就能进洞保帕了。

sentences.en: Golf for William has lots in common with the violin.
sentences.zh: 对威廉来说，高尔夫和拉小提琴有很多共同点。

sentences.en: Both draw on individual effort, on practice.
sentences.zh: 两者都依赖个人努力和练习。

sentences.en: Golf has also done something else for William.
sentences.zh: 高尔夫对威廉还有另一层意义。

sentences.en: It's given him insight into taking responsibility for the broken pieces of his life.
sentences.zh: 它让他学会了如何为自己破碎的生活承担责任。

sentences.en: When you're playing golf, you hit a ball in the trees.
sentences.zh: 当你打高尔夫时，球可能会打进树林里。

sentences.en: You know, you hit it there.
sentences.zh: 你知道，球就是打到那儿了。

sentences.en: And you can be upset about that all you want, but it doesn't change the fact that the ball is in the trees.
sentences.zh: 你可以为此感到沮丧，但这改变不了球在树林里的事实。

sentences.en: And you still have to get that ball in the hole.
sentences.zh: 你依然得想办法把球打进洞里。

sentences.en: So now you have to treat it as if your ball was always in the trees.
sentences.zh: 所以现在你必须把它当作球本来就在树林里一样来处理。

sentences.en: And you just have to figure out the best shot to hit from there and see what the best score you can make of it is.
sentences.zh: 你只需要找出从那儿打出的最佳击球方式，看看能打出的最好成绩是多少。

sentences.en: That's what William is doing now, figuring out how to move on from the mistake he made and all the loss that followed.
sentences.zh: 这就是威廉现在正在做的事，弄清楚如何从他犯下的错误以及随之而来的所有损失中走出来。

sentences.en: He says he's choosing a path of complete honesty.
sentences.zh: 他说他选择了一条完全诚实的道路。

sentences.en: And that's why he's decided to tell us what happened.
sentences.zh: 这就是他决定告诉我们发生了什么的原因。

sentences.en: In the fall of 2016, William was starting his senior year of high school and thinking hard about college.
sentences.zh: 2016年秋天，威廉刚开始读高三，正认真考虑大学的事。

sentences.en: He wanted a college that valued learning for learning's sake, for the joy that came with epiphanies.
sentences.zh: 他想找一所为了学习而学习、能从顿悟中获得快乐的大学。

sentences.en: He was less interested in a college that merely sought to prepare him for employment.
sentences.zh: 他不太想去那种仅仅为了就业做准备的大学。

sentences.en: And because he's William, and because he loves a challenge, he decided to go for it, to try for Harvard.
sentences.zh: 因为他是威廉，又因为他热爱挑战，他决定放手一搏，尝试申请哈佛。

sentences.en: I had kind of figured that I didn't have that great of a shot of being accepted.
sentences.zh: 我当时觉得我被录取的几率并不大。

sentences.en: William felt he wasn't in the same league as kids who get into Harvard.
sentences.zh: 威廉觉得自己和那些能进哈佛的孩子不是一个档次的。

sentences.en: He assumed most kids who made it were nationally recognized in some way.
sentences.zh: 他以为大多数能进哈佛的孩子在某些方面都是全国知名的。

sentences.en: So I, you know, didn't have the opportunities to do great research at great universities in high school still,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我在高中时并没有机会在顶尖大学做伟大的研究，

sentences.en: or doing really cool projects for science fairs, like national science fairs.
sentences.zh: 或者参加像全国科学竞赛那样很酷的项目。

sentences.en: Never heard of, like, the International Math Olympiad or International Physics Olympiad.
sentences.zh: 我从没听说过什么国际数学奥林匹克竞赛或国际物理奥林匹克竞赛。

sentences.en: So I kind of figured where I was at, if I got in, it would just be because they liked me for some reason.
sentences.zh: 所以我大概衡量了一下自己的处境，如果我被录取了，那肯定是因为他们出于某种原因看中了我。

sentences.en: And what are the chances of that?
